articles.summary: GEORGE TOWN, Cayman Islands, Oct. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Consolidated Water Co. Ltd. (NASDAQ Global Select Market: CWCO), a leading designer, builder and operator of advanced water treatment plants, today announced that its U.S. subsidiary, PERC Water Corporation, has been awarded a design-build agreement by the City of Pismo Beach, California, valued at approximately $39.8 million for the Central Coast Blue Advanced Water Purification Facility. The award followed a public, two-step competitive procurement process. After evaluating proposals from three qualified design-build teams, including extensive interviews, the City determined that PERC Water submitted the best overall proposal. Under the agreement, PERC Water will design, construct and test the facility, train City personnel and support initial operations. articles.title: Consolidated Water Awarded $39.8 Million Design-Build Agreement for Central Coast Blue Advanced Water Purification Facility
